headline: Cal Poly Pomona top the table on six goals conceded
dek: Cal Poly Pomona have lost only twice all season, most recently at home to UC Merced. Cal State LA have beaten UC Merced and Cal State San Bernardino at home this month, and meet UC Merced again on Friday.
